description: Iovaria wears a floor-length burgundy-plum overdress with gold woven geometric borders over an ivory linen dress. The opaque structured bodice has a low square neckline and decorated shoulder straps with round metal brooches. Ivory sleeves rest below the shoulders, while a matching burgundy bordered wrap drapes over her forearms. A narrow patterned belt has a round central clasp. A pendant and small wrist ornament provide restrained jewelry. The ivory center skirt has a walking opening below the knee, revealing brown strapped leather shoes. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
